name: BSP_GameSettings_GetLanguageName
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Direct callee of BSP_Application_Initialize (0073d410); analysis-only packet app_initialize_map, no reconstruction. Called at 0073e06a immediately before the localisation table load. Indexes DAT_00f88974 by this+4 with stride 0x20, returning field +4 or the fallback &DAT_00f88a3c. The language interpretation comes from the language, english, german, french, italian and spanish strings in 008d8190. Evidence: docs/APP_INITIALIZE_MAP.md; reports/app_initialize_map.json. | Packet app_init_locale: reconstructed. __thiscall, ECX = the settings object at 00f88980 (0073e05e), no stack argument, RET. Entry stride 0x20, field +4 is the lanfile string from the lockit/*.lng descriptor, built by 008d7bc0. Fallback 00f88a3c is the empty string, not a language name. The result becomes the .lan base name at 0073e08f. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_LOCALE.md.

name: BSP_GameSettings_GetLanguageFontPath
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall, ECX = the settings object at 00f88980, no stack argument, RET. Same shape as 008d4870: index = [ECX+4], entry = [00f88974] + index*0x20. Returns entry+0x1c when entry+0x18 is nonzero, else the empty string 00ce3a0c. Entry+0x18/+0x1c is the fontpath pair filled by 008d7bc0 from the lockit/*.lng key "fontpath" (00d15d5c). Sole caller 0073bae0 feeds it to the font descriptor load. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_LOCALE.md; reports/app_init_locale.json.

name: BSP_GameSettings_BuildLanguageTable
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Builds the language table behind the pointer global 00f88974 once, gated on 00f88978. Seeds "lockit" (00d5bce0 region, 00d15e08) and ".lng" (00d15e10) and enumerates the descriptors; the hardcoded names at 00d15d88..00d15df4 are lockit/englishauthentic.lng, lockit/spanish.lng, lockit/german.lng, lockit/italian.lng, lockit/french.lng and lockit/english.lng. Each descriptor is a whitespace-separated key/value text matched case-insensitively against "lanfile" (00d15d80), "lockit_id" (00d15d74), "voice_dir" (00d15d68) and "fontpath" (00d15d5c), stored as the four {size,pointer} pairs of the 0x20-byte entry. Confirmed against the installed lockit/englishauthentic.lng. Evidence: docs/APP_INIT_LOCALE.md; reports/app_init_locale.json.
